name: spring-drawer
title: Spring Drawer
description: A drawer that follows the finger 1:1 during drag and uses a velocity-aware spring on release: fast flicks complete the gesture even past the halfway mark, slow drags need majority travel — gesture semantics done properly.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Drag To Dismiss: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
